notes.title: What's happening with Natural Instincts?
notes.content:
Hello,

We've kept silent for a bit, and we're sorry that you've been kept in the dark. Your reviews and feedback about survival and city-building features made us discuss our ideas all over again. We would love to realize our vision, but only if you, as this game's players base, like it. That's why we've taken more time to rethink its further development. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/0b58dc2cb6851b209184dd39ceed186561f86223.png

 We must ask you for a bit more patience. I know it's a lot to ask as you've been waiting for more specific information. 

 Yes, we're fixing the wolves campaign. 
 Yes, we're fixing bugs causing the game to crash. 
 We're trying to find a solution to improve the optimization further. 

And yes, we have a lot of ideas for the game's development, but we're trying to meet you in the middle. And we're full of hope that you will be happy when we're ready to share details with you. 

However, we don't want to talk about things that are still only ideas in our heads. We've got your feedback on adding city-building elements (such as river dams, feeding trays, bridges placed above roads so animals could cross safely, and so on) and survival ones. We're discussing what we can do. We've asked more players to play and give us their feedback as well, just to gain as many notes as possible.

This is not the end of Natural Instincts. It's just the beginning. And trust me, we love this project way too much to leave it in Early Access forever. 

Stay safe, stay positive, and may your 2022 be full of joy and great games!
Natural Instincts team

notes.title: About first fixes and updates!
notes.content:
Hello, Guardians!

Wow, where did that time go? It has been a week since Natural Instincts launched in Early Access. Meanwhile, you have written over 50 reviews and provided us with TONS of valuable feedback. Thanks to you we have a lot to discuss. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/634a8fc08608b8a621b5eb8472c8bc173affa57b.png

In the meantime, we've been working hard on improving the game. Here is a list of fixes that we have provided over the last week:

 Fixes to issues with time changing button

 Fixes to selecting units

 Fixed minor quest issues 
 Fixed rabbit campaign cutscenes

 Fixes to Steam API communication
 Fixes to issues related to animal names 
 Fixed bug related to children highlight

[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/d06a6f4b78d06d7c69a6355013b5baf9930d62b6.png

We keep working on the game's optimization and lowering its hardware requirements. It will take a lot of time, so we must ask for your patience. We are also discussing and analyzing all of your suggestions and notes. Thank you for taking the time to write them! Thank you for taking the time to show our game on Youtube and Twitch. Thank you for taking the time to review it! Your support means a lot to us, and we would never dare to dream about such an active community!

Stay with us, keep supporting the game, and keep an eye on its development! 

Stay safe,
Natural Instincts team

notes.title: Natural Instincts is live in Early Access!
notes.content:
Dear Guardians,

The day has come! Natural Instincts Early Access is out now with a special 10% launch discount! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/850c6cce00d91420b5b8b91f7139f5fb58751962.png

Help the animal kingdom flourish!

Dive deep into the forests filled with birdsong, fascinating animals, and various challenges. Natural Instincts is a relaxing experience that gives you an insight into the wildlife of European forests. Learn about the different species and protect them and their environment. Keep the dangers away from the animals and help them breed so that their packs, colonies, and families can grow. Be careful, though, as the balance in the environment is very fragile.

You can lead the animals to extermination or make their population thrive. It all depends on you!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/0bd4940408e7b92482da875cdc2b07bb6d16bea1.jpg

Early Access

Don't forget that Natural Instincts launches in Early Access! It is not fully optimized yet, and we plan to work on that in the future. The game also has high hardware requirements at the moment, so it may not run well on all configurations. Remember to check the game's minimum requirements on its Steam page.

Thank you for patiently waiting for this day! Your feedback helped us create this magical experience and we can't wait to get your opinions on it.

Unleash your natural instincts... and relax!
Natural Instincts Team

notes.title: Natural Instincts - your feedback and two more campaigns
notes.content:
Hi there!

Today we have a couple of pieces of information for you!

Closed beta tests feedback

First of all, we want to thank you for all the feedback that you've sent after participating in the closed beta tests. Every comment and every note were thoroughly analyzed by our team and we figured out how to fix most of the things you've mentioned so far. Thanks to you, we know which elements of the gameplay require the most attention from us and we're already working on improving them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/186b101f46575cdd788db4da7527ee752535276f.gif

Two more stories mode

Those of you who participated in the closed beta tests had a chance to try the Freeplay version of the game as well as the first story mode focused on wolves. We are preparing two more campaigns - one about rabbits and one about boars. They will be available for the Early Access release on July 1, 2021.

Discord server

Please, remember that if you want to contact us about the game  the fastest way to get to us is to join our Discord server! You can leave your suggestions on the game there as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/0527b2b5e0f55d987e7e7af16808dbe7afc1e567.gif

That's it for now! Thank you for your attention and remember to add Natural Instincts to your wishlist and follow the game to get regular updates on its development process :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1168610/Natural_Instincts/

Best regards,
Natural Instincts Team

notes.title: Natural Instincts Update
notes.content:
Time for some updates!

The last few months have been intense for us. A lot happened in Natural Instincts, although we mainly focused on fixing bugs reported by our players.


We have some good news, though! Another update is coming to Steam soon, along with many optimization changes and some practical solutions that we will reveal to you with the new version's release!

We know you're looking forward to the game launch. Still, an additional biome and your extensive, though precious, feedback has proven to be so time-consuming that we have to postpone the release date - we want to release the game in a form promised during the Kickstarter campaign. 


Thank you for your patience! 
For the newest updates and latest reports from Natural Instincts, visit and follow us on Twitter and Facebook!

You did it! We are already over 100% funded!

Your support; not only the financial one, but also every kind word about the project, every share on social media, or every comment about you expectations, all of these makes us believe that we can achieve something meaningful. Thank you all from the bottom of our hearts!

This is not the end though! We have prepared for you many more challenging biomes, which we decided to set as our stretch goals. Guide the lions in hot Africa or lead the stock of penguins in ice-covered arctic. How many biomes we will bring to life depends on you and your support!
